meta.title: DONUT · TrOCR · YOLO Finetuning Parameter Reference
meta.description: Structured parameter reference for AI agents. Each parameter has a machine-readable schema with type, default, range, category, and impact notes.

donut.name: DONUT
donut.task: OCR-free visual document understanding (parsing, classification, VQA)

parameters.name: input_size
parameters.description: Image resolution fed to the Swin encoder. Width × Height. Pre-training used [2560,1920]; finetuning commonly downscaled to [1280,960] or [960,720] to reduce VRAM. Mismatch from pre-train causes partial weight re-initialization of position embeddings and patch embed, but training continues correctly.
parameters.notes: Must be multiples of patch_size (32). Very large reductions from pretrain resolution may hurt convergence.

parameters.name: train_batch_sizes
parameters.description: Per-device batch sizes for training. Usually 1–2 on a single consumer GPU; can be [8] with larger GPUs or gradient accumulation.
parameters.notes: List format because DONUT supports multi-dataset training with different batch sizes.

parameters.name: val_batch_sizes
parameters.description: Per-device batch sizes for validation.

parameters.name: max_length
parameters.description: Maximum decoder output token length. Caps the generated JSON sequence length. Longer documents or more complex JSON outputs require larger values. Larger values increase memory quadratically (attention).

parameters.name: lr
parameters.description: Peak learning rate with AdamW optimizer. 3e-5 is the official CORD finetune default. Use 2e-5 for smaller datasets to avoid catastrophic forgetting.

parameters.name: max_epochs
parameters.description: Number of full passes over the training data. Set to -1 when using max_steps instead. WARNING: setting both max_epochs > 0 and max_steps > 0 causes division-by-zero on CPU.

parameters.name: max_steps
parameters.description: If > 0, overrides max_epochs. Useful for CPU training where epoch-based training causes division-by-zero. Set max_epochs=-1 when using max_steps.
parameters.notes: Use max_steps for CPU runs or when you want step-based control.

parameters.name: warmup_steps
parameters.description: Linear LR warmup steps before reaching peak LR. Recommended ≈10% of total training steps. Formula: total_steps = (num_training_samples_per_epoch / batch_size) × max_epochs.

parameters.name: gradient_clip_val
parameters.description: Global gradient norm clipping threshold. Prevents exploding gradients in the transformer decoder. 1.0 is the universal default.

parameters.name: align_long_axis
parameters.description: Whether to rotate portrait images to landscape orientation to better utilise horizontal text reading. Usually False for structured documents like receipts. Set True if documents have variable orientations.

parameters.name: num_training_samples_per_epoch
parameters.description: Number of training samples drawn per epoch. Set to -1 to use all available training samples. Useful to control iteration count when dataset is very large or very small.

parameters.name: check_val_every_n_epoch
parameters.description: Run validation every N epochs. Reduce to 1 for small datasets to catch early convergence.

parameters.name: val_check_interval
parameters.description: Validation frequency within an epoch. Float = fraction of epoch (0.2 = validate 5× per epoch). Int = number of steps. Use 0.2 for fast-converging small datasets.

parameters.name: num_nodes
parameters.description: Number of compute nodes for multi-node distributed training.

parameters.name: num_workers
parameters.description: DataLoader worker processes for parallel image loading. Set to 0 for debugging.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducible training runs.

parameters.name: sort_json_key
parameters.description: Whether to sort JSON keys alphabetically when preparing ground truth tokens. MUST be False for preprocessed datasets like CORD-v2. Setting True on CORD corrupts token ordering.
parameters.notes: CRITICAL: set False for CORD-v2. Can be True for raw JSON datasets that need normalization.

parameters.name: precision
parameters.description: PyTorch Lightning precision flag. 16 = FP16 AMP mixed precision, halving VRAM usage and accelerating training on Tensor Core GPUs. 32 = full precision. bf16 = bfloat16 (Ampere+ GPUs).

parameters.name: weight_decay
parameters.description: L2 regularisation on AdamW optimizer parameters.

parameters.name: gradient_accumulation_steps
parameters.description: Accumulate gradients over N steps before optimizer update. Effective batch = batch_size × gradient_accumulation_steps. Use to simulate larger batches on VRAM-constrained hardware.

parameters.name: swin_window_size
parameters.description: Swin Transformer attention window size. donut-base uses 10; donut-proto used 8. CHANGING THIS from the pretrain value forces re-initialization of all attention weights — effectively trains from scratch. Do not change unless deliberately retraining the backbone.
parameters.notes: RARELY DOCUMENTED in finetuning guides. One of the most impactful hidden parameters.

parameters.name: encoder_layer_depths
parameters.description: Swin encoder stage depths. donut-base = {2,2,14,2}; donut-proto = {2,2,18,2}. Only relevant if training a custom base model from scratch.

parameters.name: decoder_layers
parameters.description: Number of BART decoder transformer layers.

parameters.name: resume_from_checkpoint_path
parameters.description: Path to a PyTorch Lightning checkpoint to resume training from. Set to checkpoint path string to continue interrupted training.

trocr.name: TrOCR
trocr.task: Line-level text recognition (printed, handwritten, scene text)

parameters.name: input_size
parameters.description: All input images are ALWAYS resized to 384×384 before patch extraction. This is hardcoded by the DeiT/BEiT encoder architecture — it is NOT configurable without re-training the encoder. Non-square originals are distorted. For wide text strips (e.g. 1700×134), this causes significant aspect ratio distortion.
parameters.notes: Known limitation — discussed in microsoft/unilm issue #674. Workaround: pad image to square before resizing, or use sliding window.

parameters.name: patch_size
parameters.description: Each image is divided into 16×16 pixel patches. (384/16)² = 576 patch tokens are fed to the encoder. Not configurable without changing architecture.

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Per-GPU batch size. Official Microsoft training used BSZ=8 across 8 GPUs = 64 effective batch. Community finetuning uses 4–16 per GPU.

parameters.name: learning_rate
parameters.description: Peak LR with Adam optimizer. Official training: 2e-5. Community HF finetuning typically uses 4e-5–5e-5 for smaller datasets. Lower LR reduces catastrophic forgetting of pretrained features.

parameters.name: lr_scheduler
parameters.description: LR schedule type. Official uses inverse square-root warmup decay. HuggingFace Trainer default is linear. Cosine is recommended for longer finetune runs.

parameters.name: warmup_updates
parameters.description: Steps of linear LR warmup before decay schedule begins.

parameters.name: warmup_init_lr
parameters.description: Starting LR at the very first warmup step. Prevents unstable initial gradient updates. Only in fairseq config — absent from most blog posts.
parameters.notes: OFTEN MISSING from tutorials. Too-high value causes early divergence.

parameters.name: max_epoch
parameters.description: Maximum training epochs. Official used 300 with patience=20 early stopping. Community finetuning typically 5–30 epochs with small datasets.

parameters.name: patience
parameters.description: Early stopping: halt if no CER improvement for N epochs. Use 3–5 for community finetuning; 20 for full official training.

parameters.name: weight_decay
parameters.description: L2 regularisation coefficient on Adam optimizer.

parameters.name: fp16
parameters.description: FP16 AMP mixed precision training. Enabled via --fp16 in official fairseq script. Reduces VRAM ~50%, speeds training ~1.5–2× on Tensor Core GPUs.

parameters.name: adam_beta1
parameters.description: Adam first moment decay rate.

parameters.name: adam_beta2
parameters.description: Adam second moment decay rate.

parameters.name: adam_epsilon
parameters.description: Adam numerical stability epsilon term.

parameters.name: update_freq
parameters.description: Gradient accumulation factor in fairseq. update_freq=4 with BSZ=2 = effective BSZ of 8. Maps to gradient_accumulation_steps in HuggingFace Trainer.
parameters.notes: NAMING DIFFERENCE causes confusion when porting fairseq configs to HF.

parameters.name: preprocess
parameters.description: Data augmentation preset for training images. DA2 is stronger augmentation used in official IAM finetuning. Using no augmentation gives significantly worse CER.
parameters.notes: Fairseq-specific parameter. HF training uses separate augmentation transforms.

parameters.name: num_workers
parameters.description: DataLoader worker processes.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed.

parameters.name: bpe
parameters.description: Byte-pair encoding method for the decoder vocabulary. gpt2 BPE is the default. Use sentencepiece with --sentencepiece-model for multilingual models.

parameters.name: decoder_pretrained
parameters.description: Which pretrained checkpoint to initialize the text decoder from. roberta2 for printed/scene text. unilm for handwritten text.

parameters.name: arch
parameters.description: Model size variant. large: 558M params, 384px encoder; base: 334M; small: 62M. Larger = better accuracy, more VRAM, slower inference.

parameters.name: max_length
parameters.description: Maximum token sequence length during autoregressive decoding. TrOCR processes line-cropped images; 64 tokens covers most text lines. Use 512 for full-document inference.

parameters.name: predict_with_generate
parameters.description: Must be True for CER/WER evaluation during training in HuggingFace Seq2SeqTrainer. When False, uses teacher-forcing logits for loss only.

parameters.name: lora_rank
parameters.description: LoRA rank for parameter-efficient finetuning. Used in DLoRA-TrOCR: LoRA applied to decoder, DoRA applied to encoder. Reduces trainable params from 334M to <10M with minimal accuracy loss.
parameters.notes: PEFT approach — not in original TrOCR paper. From Chang et al. 2024.

parameters.name: use_dora_encoder
parameters.description: Apply DoRA (weight decomposition adapter) to ViT encoder instead of standard LoRA. Achieves comparable or better accuracy than full finetuning with drastically fewer trainable parameters.
parameters.notes: DLoRA-TrOCR paper: encoder uses DoRA, decoder uses LoRA.

yolo.name: YOLO
yolo.architecture: CSPDarknet backbone + FPN/PAN neck + detection head
yolo.task: Object detection, instance segmentation, pose estimation, classification

parameters.name: imgsz
parameters.description: Square input resolution. Images are auto-resized and letterboxed to this size. Larger = better small object detection, more VRAM, slower training. Must match between training and inference.
parameters.notes: For high-res images (>2MP), use sliding window instead of single large imgsz.

parameters.name: batch
parameters.description: Images per training step. -1 = auto (fills ~60% GPU VRAM). Float 0.0–1.0 = VRAM fraction. Larger batches stabilise gradients but require more memory. OOM triggers auto-retry with halved batch.

parameters.name: epochs
parameters.description: Number of full training passes. Default 100 for finetuning; 300 for training from scratch. Use patience for early stopping to prevent overfitting.

parameters.name: lr0
parameters.description: Initial (peak) learning rate. SGD default 0.01; AdamW default ~0.001. Lower values recommended for finetuning to avoid overwriting pretrained features.

parameters.name: lrf
parameters.description: Final LR as a fraction of lr0. Controls cosine/linear decay endpoint: final_lr = lr0 × lrf.

parameters.name: momentum
parameters.description: SGD momentum / Adam beta1. Controls gradient history weighting.

parameters.name: weight_decay
parameters.description: L2 regularisation. Helps prevent overfitting on small datasets.

parameters.name: warmup_epochs
parameters.description: Linear LR warmup from near-zero to lr0 over N epochs at training start.

parameters.name: warmup_momentum
parameters.description: Starting SGD momentum value during warmup phase.

parameters.name: warmup_bias_lr
parameters.description: Starting LR specifically for bias parameters during warmup.

parameters.name: amp
parameters.description: Automatic Mixed Precision (FP16/FP32). On by default. Reduces VRAM ~50%, speeds training. Disable (amp=False) if you see NaN losses in early training. OOM triggers auto-halved batch retry (single GPU only).

parameters.name: optimizer
parameters.description: 'auto' selects AdamW for ≤10 warmup epochs, SGD otherwise. Explicit AdamW recommended for finetuning. SGD recommended for full training from scratch with 300+ epochs.

parameters.name: cos_lr
parameters.description: Use cosine annealing LR schedule (smoother decay). Recommended for longer runs. When False, uses linear decay.

parameters.name: patience
parameters.description: Early stopping: halt training if no mAP50-95 improvement for N epochs. Set lower (10–20) for fast finetuning; higher for uncertain convergence.

parameters.name: freeze
parameters.description: Freeze N backbone layers (int) or specific layer indices (list). freeze=10 freezes entire backbone, trains only detection head. Dramatically reduces training time and overfitting for small datasets.
parameters.notes: THE most impactful underdocumented parameter for domain finetuning.

parameters.name: close_mosaic
parameters.description: Disable mosaic augmentation for the last N epochs of training. Stabilises final learning phase and improves mAP convergence. Rarely mentioned in basic tutorials.
parameters.notes: CRITICALLY IMPORTANT for final accuracy. Do not set to 0.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Rectangular training: batches images by similar aspect ratio to reduce letterbox padding waste. Incompatible with DataLoader shuffle — silently disables shuffle when set to True.
parameters.notes: WARNING: silently disables shuffle. Can bias training if unaware.

parameters.name: multi_scale
parameters.description: Randomly vary imgsz by ±50% each batch during training. Improves multi-scale object detection robustness. Increases training time.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: 'ram' caches entire dataset in memory for maximum I/O speed. 'disk' caches preprocessed images. Dramatically speeds up training when dataset fits in RAM.

parameters.name: workers
parameters.description: DataLoader worker threads per GPU rank.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed.

parameters.name: deterministic
parameters.description: Forces CUDA deterministic algorithms. Slight training speed penalty.

parameters.name: fraction
parameters.description: Fraction of dataset to use for training. Reduce (e.g. 0.1) for fast hyperparameter sweep experiments. Proportionally reduces training time.
parameters.notes: Underused but very practical for HPO.

parameters.name: dropout
parameters.description: Dropout probability in classification head. Use 0.1–0.2 for small datasets to prevent overfitting.

parameters.name: single_cls
parameters.description: Treat all classes as a single class. Useful for binary detection (object/background) tasks.

parameters.name: save_period
parameters.description: Save checkpoint every N epochs. -1 = only save best.pt and last.pt.

parameters.name: mosaic
parameters.description: Probability of mosaic augmentation: combines 4 training images into one 2×2 grid. Massively improves detection of objects in varied contexts. Disabled for last close_mosaic epochs.

parameters.name: mixup
parameters.description: Probability of mixup: blends two images and their labels. Improves generalisation. Use 0.1–0.2 max; too high hurts precision.

parameters.name: copy_paste
parameters.description: Probability of copy-paste: copies object instances from one image to another. Very effective for rare-class augmentation in imbalanced datasets.

parameters.name: hsv_h
parameters.description: Hue jitter magnitude. Helps with varying lighting and colour conditions.

parameters.name: hsv_s
parameters.description: Saturation jitter magnitude.

parameters.name: hsv_v
parameters.description: Brightness/value jitter magnitude.

parameters.name: fliplr
parameters.description: Horizontal flip probability. Set 0 if left-right orientation matters (e.g. text, asymmetric objects).

parameters.name: flipud
parameters.description: Vertical flip probability. Set 0 if vertical orientation matters (most use cases).

parameters.name: translate
parameters.description: Random translation as fraction of image size.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Random scale (zoom) augmentation range. Critical for detecting objects at varying distances.

parameters.name: shear
parameters.description: Shear transformation in degrees.

parameters.name: perspective
parameters.description: Random perspective distortion coefficient.

parameters.name: degrees
parameters.description: Random rotation range in degrees. Set 0 if object orientation matters.

parameters.name: bgr
parameters.description: Probability of randomly swapping BGR channel order. Guards against incorrect channel ordering in deployment.

parameters.name: box
parameters.description: Bounding box regression loss weight (GIoU/CIoU loss coefficient). Increase for tight localisation tasks.

parameters.name: cls
parameters.description: Classification loss weight. Increase for many-class tasks where classification accuracy is critical.

parameters.name: dfl
parameters.description: Distribution Focal Loss weight for fine-grained bounding box regression.

parameters.name: iou
parameters.description: IoU threshold for Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) during inference. Higher = fewer boxes, allows more overlap.

parameters.name: conf
parameters.description: Minimum confidence threshold for predictions. Lower = more detections, more false positives.

parameters.name: max_det
parameters.description: Maximum number of detections per image after NMS.

cross_model_notes.note: All three support FP16 AMP. All are safe to enable on Tensor Core GPUs (NVIDIA V100, A100, RTX series). Disable if NaN losses appear.

cross_model_notes.yolo: Not directly exposed; use smaller batch + amp instead
cross_model_notes.note: TrOCR fairseq uses 'update_freq' not 'gradient_accumulation_steps' — common porting confusion.

cross_model_notes.trocr: FIXED at 384×384. Not configurable without re-training encoder.
cross_model_notes.yolo: Configurable imgsz. Default: 640. Must match train/inference.
cross_model_notes.note: TrOCR's fixed resolution is a known limitation for wide-aspect text strips.

cross_model_notes.donut: No native freeze parameter; freeze manually via requires_grad=False
cross_model_notes.trocr: Freeze encoder layers manually via requires_grad=False
cross_model_notes.note: YOLO freeze parameter is the most ergonomic. Others require manual intervention.

cross_model_notes.donut: N/A — autoregressive token generation, no spatial upsampling in output
cross_model_notes.trocr: N/A — autoregressive token generation, no spatial upsampling in output
cross_model_notes.yolo: nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode='nearest') in FPN/PAN neck. Not a training parameter — architectural constant.
cross_model_notes.note: Upsampling in YOLO is architectural (feature pyramid), not a tunable hyperparameter.

commonly_underdocumented.reason: Changing from pretrain value forces full weight re-init — effectively trains from scratch. Never mentioned in finetuning tutorials.
Rotating portrait documents can significantly improve text extraction quality but is off by default with no explanation.
Must be False for CORD-v2. Setting True silently corrupts token ordering in preprocessed datasets.
Setting both > 0 causes division-by-zero on CPU. Undocumented trap in PyTorch Lightning training script.
Starting LR at warmup step 0. Too high causes early divergence. Present in fairseq script but absent from all blog posts.
Different names in fairseq vs HuggingFace. Causes silent config errors when porting.
Official augmentation pipeline is DA2 for IAM. Omitting gives significantly worse CER. Not mentioned in HF tutorials.
Most impactful parameter for domain finetuning on small datasets. Freezing backbone prevents overfitting and reduces training time dramatically. Underemphasised in tutorials.
Disabling mosaic for final 10 epochs is crucial for mAP convergence. Almost never mentioned in basic tutorials.
rect=True silently disables DataLoader shuffle. Can cause systematic batch bias without user awareness.
YOLO silently halves batch size on CUDA OOM. Can cause inconsistent effective batch sizes across experiment runs.
Can be a float (0.2 = validate 5× per epoch) — crucial for fast-converging small datasets. Documented but rarely used.
Subset training for fast HPO sweeps. Essentially invisible in documentation.
PEFT approach reducing trainable params from 334M to <10M. Not in original TrOCR docs; from 2024 DLoRA-TrOCR paper.
